neighbours.label: Nouns and adjectives of aversion or harm felt toward something (dislike of, fear of, discrimination, concerned about); warmer or neutral words in the same frames stay lower. A broad pole
fire: Her aunt's distaste for the city was not reduced by this.
Racial discrimination in hiring remains a serious problem.
Farmers are worried about the safety of the new dam.
He could not go back because of a deep fear of reprisals.
Their hatred of the old regime grew every year.
Many residents dread the coming floods.
His suspicion of doctors kept him away from clinics.
The prejudice of the past still shapes these towns.
quiet: Her aunt's trip to the city was not delayed by this.

Farmers are located north of the new dam.
